chunks: And with this chain of transmission: concerning

About a man whose hand is broken and then heals, he said: “Retaliation is not taken from him, but rather al-arsh is given.” ʿAlī said: And Jamīl was asked, “How much is the compensation in the tooth and the breaking of the hand?” He said: “A slight amount.” And he did not narrate in it anything definite.
ai.seo_question: If a person’s broken hand heals, is qiṣāṣ applied or is financial compensation paid instead?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning bodily injury when a broken hand heals. It states that qiṣāṣ is not carried out in such a case; instead, financial compensation is given, though no precisely fixed amount is reported here for such compensation in the case of a tooth or a broken hand.
